newsitem.title: USA: AMR seeks engines for up to 50 Boeing 777s.
newsitem.headline: AMR seeks engines for up to 50 Boeing 777s.

text.p: AMR Corp said Thursday it is in talks with manufactures for engines to power 12 Boeing Co 777 jets it ordered as part of a larger deal valued at about $6.5 billion.
AMR Thursday ordered a total of 103 Boeing jets, ranging in size from 737s to 777s. It also has purchase rights to acquire 527 more planes, including 38 more 777 models.

The new 757s and 767s, like existing models in AMR's fleet, will have Rolls-Royce Plc and General Electric engines, respectively. The 737s will have engines from CFM, a joint venture between General Electric and Snecma of France, AMR said.
AMR declined to comment on when it will name a manufacturer for the 777 engines.
